title: Gaussian quadrant probability at a threshold
statement: Let $0<\rho<1$ and $t\in\mathbb R$. For a pair of standard Gaussian random variables with correlation $\rho$, the probability that both coordinates exceed $t$ equals the correlated Gaussian measure of the upper right quadrant above $t$.
